digest.component_or_area: plan review and code review gates
propositions: Two regexes and one scope extractor key on the '## Success Criteria' heading; pointing them at '## Acceptance Criteria' tightens the gate by ensuring criteria written under SC never bypass the P1 blocking floor.

The epic branch of _clarity_score must repoint its +2 bonus from '## Success Criteria' to '## Acceptance Criteria' to preserve the current clarity-check score (6) and avoid regressions across 108 real tickets in the store.

All test fixtures embedding '## Success Criteria' in ticket descriptions must be migrated: fixtures with both headings drop the SC block; fixtures with only SC rename it to '## Acceptance Criteria' and convert bullets to '- [ ]' items.
The two _clarity_score copies in gates.py and det_floor.py must remain textually in lockstep via their epic branches, preserving the module-comment-asserted invariant that ties them together.

A new contract test must assert that an epic carrying '## Acceptance Criteria' and '## Context' passes both clarity-check and check-ac, and that _clarity_score(fixture, 'epic') equals 6 to prove score neutrality of the repoint.

All occurrences of '## Success Criteria' must be removed from production code and test fixture corpus, with remaining occurrences in test_criteria_heading_collapse.py serving only as negative-case proofs that the heading is inert.
